lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to buy a clay jar from a potter and go to the Valley of Ben-hinnom.
The LORD says He will bring disaster on Judah because they abandoned Him and burned their children as offerings to Baal.
The LORD says the place will be called the Valley of Slaughter, and passersby will be appalled and scoff at her wounds.
Jeremiah shatters the jar before the men with him, and the LORD says the dead will be buried in Shiloh.
Jeremiah stands in the palace of the king of Judah and proclaims that the LORD will bring every disaster.
